_readme: EDIT THIS FILE, then run `npm run build`. Every ability below is a DRAFT seeded from standard Echoes-of-Faydwer (level 70) Inquisitor knowledge and is marked (verify) where the exact name/behaviour may differ on your server (Vushi). Replace names/notes with YOUR actual spells. Structure: each role has 5 sections. Reorder items within a section to set priority (top = do first). Delete or add {name, note} items freely.
title: Inquisitor Rotation

roles.label: HEAL
roles.blurb: Group/raid main healer. Fastest recast of all priests — lead with the group reactive, cure the dangerous stuff first.

maintain.name: Malevolent Diatribe
maintain.note: group REACTIVE heal — refresh before it's consumed

opener.name: Malevolent Diatribe
opener.note: pre-cast group reactive before the pull

opener.name: Alleviation
opener.note: pre-cast if incoming AoE is expected

priority.name: Resolute Flagellant
priority.note: 1) group cure arcane+elemental — clear dangerous detrimentals FIRST (verify)

priority.name: Cure
priority.note: 2) single-target cure for the tank if a spell is killing them

priority.name: Malevolent Diatribe
priority.note: 3) main HPS — keep the group reactive rolling

priority.name: Divine Recovery
priority.note: 5) big single heal — tank spot heal (verify)

emergency.name: Divine Recovery
emergency.note: biggest single heal — tank about to die (verify)

emergency.name: Redemption
emergency.note: in-combat rez AFTER the fight is stable (verify)

cooldowns.name: (long-CD group save)
cooldowns.note: slot your best emergency/immunity here (verify what you have)

roles.label: SOLO
roles.blurb: Leveling / soloing. Land debuff + DoTs, melee auto-attack, heal yourself with the reactive as needed.

maintain.name: Heretic's Doom
maintain.note: debuff the target (dmg taken / power drain) (verify)

priority.name: auto-attack
priority.note: 5) stay in melee range, let auto-attack run between CAs

emergency.name: Condemn
emergency.note: stun/root and back off if losing (verify)

roles.label: GRP DPS
roles.blurb: Group has enough healing — push damage. Debuffs up, DoTs rolling, CA priority, keep auto-attack going. Toss a reactive only when needed.

priority.name: auto-attack
priority.note: 5) keep in melee range; weave CAs around auto-attack timer

emergency.name: Resolute Flagellant
emergency.note: you're still a priest — group cure if healer is swamped

roles.label: RAID
roles.blurb: Raid contribution beyond healing: keep raid/target debuffs + group buffs up, DPS in priority order, cover cures and interrupts.

maintain.name: Malevolent Diatribe
maintain.note: keep a reactive on the tank/group as backup

emergency.name: Divine Recovery
emergency.note: emergency heal if your group's healer drops (verify)

cooldowns.name: Verdict
cooldowns.note: line up with raid burst windows (verify)
